metadata.description: The dev-prune (devp) skill: reclaim disk space from idle Git repositories, safely.

plugins.name: dev-prune
plugins.description: Teaches Claude the dev-prune (devp) CLI: how to reclaim disk space by deleting dependency and build directories a lockfile can rebuild, how to put them back, the safety rules it will not cross, its exit codes, its --json contract, and its troubleshooting tree.
